faces.name: Shape Stealer
faces.oracle_text: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, change this creature's base power and toughness to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

triggered.raw_text: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, change this creature's base power and toughness to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

effects.text: change this creature's base power and toughness to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn
